test_data.name: hr_username
test_data.strategy: Use a pre-provisioned, non-production authorized HR user account; do not invent credentials.
constraints: Account must have HR/PIM Add Employee authorization
Must not be a production account

test_data.name: hr_password
test_data.strategy: Resolve from an approved secret store or environment variable at runtime; never hardcode.
constraints: Must never appear in code, logs, or reports

test_data.name: employee_first_name
test_data.strategy: Generate a synthetic, non-production first name at runtime.
constraints: Field-level format/length constraints not confirmed by acceptance criteria

test_data.name: employee_middle_name
test_data.strategy: Generate a synthetic, non-production middle name at runtime.
constraints: Mandatory status not confirmed by acceptance criteria

test_data.name: employee_last_name
test_data.strategy: Generate a synthetic, non-production last name at runtime.
constraints: Field-level format/length constraints not confirmed by acceptance criteria

test_data.name: employee_id
test_data.strategy: Generate a unique employee ID at runtime to avoid collisions across parallel/concurrent runs; use for creation, list verification, and post-test cleanup.
constraints: Must be unique within the shared test environment for the run duration
Uniqueness/format constraints not confirmed by acceptance criteria
test_data.cleanup_strategy: After test verification, delete the created employee record via PIM > Employee List (select record > Delete) so no residual data remains in the shared environment.

test_data.name: required_field_under_test
test_data.strategy: Identify the specific mandatory field to omit for validation testing once the mandatory-field rule is confirmed.
constraints: Which field(s) among First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Employee ID are mandatory is not stated in the acceptance criteria

test_step_data.action: Log in as an authorized HR user.
Verify a confirmation is displayed after creation.
Verify the saved employee appears in the Employee List.
Cleanup: delete the created employee record so no residual data remains in the shared environment.
Log in as an authorized HR user.
Leave the mandatory field under test blank while entering the remaining fields.
test_step_data.test_data: DATA_SOURCE_REQUIRED: required_field_under_test; employee_first_name=RUNTIME_GENERATOR: employee_first_name; employee_middle_name=RUNTIME_GENERATOR: employee_middle_name; employee_last_name=RUNTIME_GENERATOR: employee_last_name; employee_id=RUNTIME_GENERATOR: employee_id

test_step_data.action: Attempt to save the employee record.
Verify a required-field validation error is displayed and the record is not saved.
Cleanup: confirm no employee record was created; no data removal required.
